title: Universal Life Insurance Policy Data Page: Issue Limits, Face Amounts and Death Benefit Options
content:
Ashgrove issues its Universal Life Insurance in six tiers: the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL, Ashgrove Protection UL, Ashgrove Accumulation UL, Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect, Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth and Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier. Each tier issues only within the issue ages and face amounts below, offers the death benefit options shown, and stops monthly deductions after the maturity age shown while coverage continues.

## Schedule of issue and contract limits

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Issue ages (age last birthday) | 18 to 85 | 18 to 80 | 0 to 80 | 18 to 80 | 0 to 80 | 18 to 75 |
| Smallest face amount issued, and floor for face decreases | $100000 | $100000 | $50000 | $100000 | $100000 | $1000000 |
| Largest face amount on one policy | $10000000 | $10000000 | $10000000 | $10000000 | $10000000 | $25000000 |
| Underwriting at issue | Full medical | Full medical | Full medical | Full medical | Full medical | Full medical and financial |
| Death benefit options offered | A only | A or B | A or B | A or B | A or B | A or B |
| Change from Option B to Option A by request | Allowed | Allowed | Allowed | Allowed | Allowed | Allowed |
| Change from Option A to Option B by request | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| First policy year in which a requested face decrease may take effect | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Maturity age (attained age after which monthly deductions stop) | 121 | 121 | 121 | 121 | 121 | 121 |

Option A is a level death benefit equal to the face amount; Option B is the face amount plus the account value.

## Notes on the schedule

- The lowest and highest issue ages are both inclusive: the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier issues at age 75 but not at age 76; the Ashgrove Accumulation UL and Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth issue from age 0.
- The smallest face amount does two jobs: it is the least face issued on the tier and the floor below which a face decrease may not take the face.
- On the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL only Option A is offered, so an Option B policy does not arise on that tier.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A proposed insured aged 80 last birthday is within the issue ages of both the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL and the Ashgrove Protection UL; at 81 only the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL of the two remains open, its issue ages running to 85.
- A requested face amount of $750000 is below the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier's smallest face of $1000000 and is not issued on that tier, while it lies within the limits of every other tier.
